title: Binary serialization of a coded machine
statement: For a coded nondeterministic machine with $n+1$ states, serialize its state parameter in binary and pair that string with a bit string containing its initial state in unary, followed by the transition actions. The actions are listed for both choice bits, every state, and every combination of input and two work-tape symbols, with each symbol either blank, $0$, or $1$.
